title: fault_location_id v0.2.0-phase0 - Single-Ended Joint Estimation of HIF Location and Arc Resistance via Power-Frequency Admittance Identification with Dual-Channel Noise Modelling
description: Phase-0 reproducibility release of the SAMBPS DTaaS HIF transfer-function locator. Includes the camera-ready manuscript (v2), the watertight Appendix-A derivation (cascaded-Gamma state-space, KVL/KCL, closed-form H, symbolic dH/dtheta), the references.bib (44 entries across streams A-E), the canonical MATLAB and Python implementations of the two-section pi-model and two-stage joint estimator, the 720-case dataset builder, the global-optimum capture and timing study, the 9-cell hyperparameter sensitivity sweep, the cross-runtime golden-file test, and the GitHub Actions CI infrastructure (Python 3.10/3.11/3.12 matrix, optional MATLAB job, weekly DOI-rot watch).
